summary: Most requested UI-flow changes appear implemented (new Start->Menu flow, location step, prominent adult button, feelings grid, grown-ups lock screen and navigation). One clear copy requirement mismatch is present for the exact Welcome greeting punctuation/text. Several additional non-requested enhancements (PWA/manifest, audio/vibration, theming) were introduced.

missing_requirements.requirement: Update the greeting copy to exactly: “Hi, I’m Luma. I help you show how you feel.”
missing_requirements.reason: The Welcome screen greeting text does not match exactly; it uses a straight apostrophe ("I'm") instead of the required curly apostrophe ("I’m").

hallucinated_features.description: Progressive Web App (PWA) support via web manifest and related HTML/favicon changes
hallucinated_features.reason: BuildRequest does not ask for PWA/manifest functionality; these are additional platform features beyond the specified UI flow and copy changes.

hallucinated_features.description: Audio chime playback and device vibration on the adult message screen
hallucinated_features.reason: BuildRequest only specifies UI copy and flow; adding sound/vibration behavior is not requested.

hallucinated_features.description: Major new global theming/animation system (OKLCH color tokens, new animations) and Tailwind token expansion
hallucinated_features.reason: Not explicitly requested; REQ-8 is about calm/child-friendly text and presentation but does not require introducing a new theming system.
